issue.title: fix(server): preserve V2 checkpoint baselines across runs

issue.body: Full-thread diffs stop resolving their baseline after a second V2 run: the root checkpoint scope is reused, but the query searches for a scope still owned by the first run. Resolve ordinal zero from the target checkpoint scope and keep nonzero ranges within that scope. The regression builds two runs through the real ID allocator and projector, rather than inventing one scope per run. Validation: 6 focused checkpoint query tests and server typecheck passed; targeted formatting and diff checks passed. Independent Claude Opus 5 high review was attempted but authentication failed before a model ran (exit 1); the coordinator reviewed the source and regression evidence. Targets the Orchestrator V2 branch in #2829. Implemented by Codex workers and reviewed by GPT-6 in Codex/T3. --- > [!NOTE] > **Medium Risk** > Changes diff baseline semantics for multi-scope threads and reused V2 scopes; wrong refs would show incorrect patches but errors remain typed when baselines are missing. > > **Overview** > Fixes **checkpoint turn diff** baseline selection when Orchestration V2 **reuses a single root checkpoint scope** across multiple runs. Full-thread and turn diffs were failing or picking the wrong “from” ref because the query looked up the first run’s root scope or any ready checkpoint with a matching turn ordinal, ignoring which scope the target checkpoint belongs to. > > **`CheckpointDiffQuery.getTurnDiff`** now anchors the baseline to the **target checkpoint’s scope**: for `fromTurnCount === 0` it uses ordinal zero on that scope; for nonzero ranges it only considers ready checkpoints in the same scope as the `to` checkpoint. > > Tests were expanded to drive projection state through domain events and the real ID allocator (reused root scope after two runs), assert that a turn-1→2 diff does not use a same-ordinal ref from another scope, and align the missing-baseline error case with a nonzero `fromTurnCount`. > > Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit 4b2349860add76afb41004b132a91f947cf34140. Bugbot is set up for automated code reviews on this repo. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot). ## Current-base verification Updated to exact V2 base `415ed0f73b97f1655b6282492f81d0b2bba3a9cc` at head `b9316c97c2308319012edd51dff435eef86a39c4`. The original leaf plus this base synthesizes cleanly as tree `664d83a0a52b8d538568ca97811a5a82973a70eb`; current V2 base still derives turn-zero from the first run and searches nonzero ready checkpoints across scopes, so the fix is not superseded. - 6/6 focused checkpoint-diff tests pass. - Server typecheck and targeted lint pass. - Diff checks pass; the contribution remains limited to `CheckpointDiffQuery.ts` and its test. Earlier verification above retains its original scope. No live repository diff was exercised for this refresh. Fresh independent Claude review remains unavailable because OAuth is signed out; no Claude review is claimed. Refreshed by GPT-6 in the Codex harness. > [!NOTE] > ### Fix V2 checkpoint baseline resolution to use target scope in `CheckpointDiffQuery.getTurnDiff` > Changes baseline-reference resolution to operate within the target checkpoint's scope. For a zero starting turn, it creates the zero-ordinal reference for that scope; for a nonzero turn, it selects a ready checkpoint matching both the target scope and the requested run ordinal. > - Removes the old zero-turn lookup through the first run's root scope and the nonzero lookup across all ready checkpoints, which could select a baseline from an unrelated scope. > - Rewrites the tests in [CheckpointDiffQuery.test.ts](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/9896/files#diff-79db5207007364daf099ba480a41f525a2663b06ae47aa4385aa981756fb754e) as event-driven projection scenarios covering reused scopes, nonzero baselines, and the missing-baseline error contract. > - Behavioral Change: a nonzero baseline from a different scope is no longer selected; a missing same-scope baseline now yields the existing typed unavailable-reference error. > > > > Macroscope summarized b9316c9. > >
